quotes.speaker: Brayden Burries
quotes.summary_phrase: Brayden Burries on his first experience as an NBA starter
quotes.excerpt: Rookie year is everything is a first at some point. First time being introduced as a starter.
quotes.quote: Rookie year is everything is a first at some point. First time being introduced as a starter, and to kind of know that going in, but just that feel. Going through the problem and circumstance of intros and things, just what did that feel like to go through that and maybe get that out of the way if you will.
quotes.social_post: Brayden Burries reflects on his first NBA start, noting the unique feeling of going through the pregame introduction process for the first time.

quotes.speaker: Brayden Burries
quotes.summary_phrase: Brayden Burries on his pre-draft workout relationship with Caleb
quotes.excerpt: We actually did pre-draft together. So it was end of April all the way till June.
quotes.quote: We actually did pre-draft together. So it was end of April all the way till June, we were with each other pretty much every day, Monday through Friday, workouts, playing against each other, working out with one another. He is a good player.
quotes.social_post: Brayden Burries discusses his chemistry with Caleb, noting the two spent months training together daily leading up to the draft.

quotes.speaker: Brayden Burries
quotes.summary_phrase: Brayden Burries on ignoring draft position and focusing on improvement
quotes.excerpt: I just focus on me. Main focus, focusing on other people, other things, that's just wasted energy.
quotes.quote: I just focus on me. Main focus, focusing on other people, other things, that's just wasted energy. So I just focus on me, focus on how I can get better each and every day, and then over time, I'll be right where I need to be.
quotes.social_post: Brayden Burries says he is ignoring outside noise regarding his draft position, stating that focusing on others is just wasted energy.

quotes.speaker: Brayden Burries
quotes.summary_phrase: Brayden Burries on his offensive approach and maintaining shooting confidence
quotes.excerpt: Most of the shots taken are good shots, just missing, not going my way right now.
quotes.quote: Most of the shots taken are good shots, just missing, not going my way right now. And that happens. Best thing, just get back in the gym, continue to shoot, and they'll go in. The main thing is just continue to have confidence though, like that's a big thing with me, just have confidence, so when you're open, shoot it.
quotes.social_post: Brayden Burries is maintaining his confidence despite early shooting struggles, saying the main thing is to keep shooting when open.

quotes.speaker: Brayden Burries
quotes.summary_phrase: Brayden Burries on staying poised and focused on the next play
quotes.excerpt: Just stay in the moment, try to take one play at a time.
quotes.quote: Just stay in the moment, try to take one play at a time. Literally just stay in the moment, be where your feet is. If they're dribbling the ball up, just know like how can we stop them from scoring this possession, and then next possession, and then possession after that.
quotes.social_post: Brayden Burries emphasizes the importance of staying in the moment and focusing on individual defensive possessions to help the team.

quotes.speaker: Brayden Burries
quotes.summary_phrase: Brayden Burries on his next-play mentality for overcoming mistakes
quotes.excerpt: Whether you make a turnover, bad pass or miss a shot, like just next-play mentality.
quotes.quote: Whether you make a turnover, bad pass or miss a shot, like just next-play mentality. How can you impact winning on the next play? And then if you do, how can you do it again? And if you continue to do that over the course of the game, you have a good chance to win.
quotes.social_post: Brayden Burries discusses his next play mentality, focusing on how to impact winning immediately after a turnover or missed shot.
